% Pattern: head/manual. A head command with no number takes the number in the
% group after it, as \newcommand{\claim}{{\noindent \bf Claim }} and
% \claim{2}, and a case head numbers the case in parentheses, as
% {\em Case (1.1).}.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want head-1 statement/claim 2
% want head-2 other/case 1.1
% want head-3 other/case 1.2
\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\claim}{{\noindent \bf Claim }}
\begin{document}
\claim{2} Each tree with two vertices or more has a leaf.

{\em Case (1.1).} The tree is a path.

{\em Case (1.2).} The tree is not a path.
\end{document}
